entities.summary: El Comercio is a daily Ecuadorian newspaper in Quito. It covers news from inside and outside the country, although its focus is primarily on the former, especially on Quito, Guayaquil and occasionally Cuenca. It competes against El Universo for the largest print distribution in Ecuador. El Comercio is a newspaper in Americas, established in 1906. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
